title: Tesla travels to Europe to persuade Hertz he was wrong

tellings.quote: he was at least from what I've read he actually traveled uh to Europe

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla is said to have traveled to Europe to convince the physicist Heinrich Hertz that Hertz had got something wrong. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, tells this as something he has read, saying "from what I've read he actually traveled to Europe." He places it in the late 1800s, as part of a story about Tesla's ideas being pushed aside.
